identity_boundary: Haoran Xu is a source-reported employment alias for the person charged as JOHN DOE 2 in the Chapman superseding indictment. The source-scoped form 浩然 徐 remains part of that charged-alias record; charges are allegations, the defendant is presumed innocent, same-named accounts remain separate, and Rewards for Justice imagery is source context rather than an actor portrait.
